record.name: Peru
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Peru has an AI law with a regulation in force from January 2026 and a 2026-2030 national strategy, run from the digital transformation secretariat.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English searches concern the AI law, regulation, digital transformation and national strategy, without a qualifying evaluation institute. The cached official AI catalogue identifies the legal and institutional framework, not a body to evaluate advanced models. This pass did not read the full regulation or strategy and does not enlarge the existing claims about them. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

searches.query: Peru national AI safety security institute advanced model evaluation proposal government

check.language_note: The recorded es query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The government's national AI catalogue identifies administration by the Presidency's digital-government secretariat; this is limited coordination and adoption evidence.

related_bodies.name: Secretaría de Gobierno y Transformación Digital (PCM)
related_bodies.role: It leads AI policy, the national strategy and the state AI catalogue; no model evaluation mandate was found.

record.notes: The regulation (Supreme Decree 115-2025-PCM) and strategy (Ministerial Resolution 152-2026-PCM) were identified from the official catalogue page only, not read in full. The regulation was published on 9 Sep 2025 and took effect on 22 Jan 2026 (secondary source).
